cells.old: Contributory days for the pension subsystem on the 30-day commercial month. EACH SUBSYSTEM CARRIES ITS OWN DAY COUNT and they legitimately differ - which is precisely why the engine must compute and store four separate counters rather than one 'days worked'. Bidirectional set with the whole change event block (T2R2-015 to T2R2-030): those change-event flags are what drive this day count, so a change event reported without a matching movement in the day counters is a reconciliation error the operador will surface.

cells.old: Correction of an earlier return, filed through the same operador as the original return. cells.new: Correction of an earlier return, filed through the same operador as the original return. The C records must be equal to or greater than the A records in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund of amounts paid in excess. A correction made on a period that was already corrected starts from the values reported for that contributor in the last correction return. One N return is filed per corrected period, covering all the subsystems the contributor must pay, but more than one N return may be used for operational reasons, with interest on arrears where due (AT2 v30 (24-07-2026) pp.45-46). Requires the associated return number and date in T2R1-009 and T2R1-010, and the operador must settle interest on arrears except for salary retroactives and timely termination change events.

cells.old: Maps to 51. Uses the hours-worked field T2R2-096 instead of the 1-SMMLV floor.

Source: AT2 v30 (24-07-2026) p.117-118, campo 5 type 51.

Type 75 rules (AT2 v30 (24-07-2026) pp.132-133): the health fund code (T2R2-033) must be MIN005 (ADRES) and the operador validates contributor and payer against the ADRES file 'Reporte de informacion de afiliados con permanencia en el regimen subsidiado' for the period; the type contributes to health, pension, occupational risk, CCF, SENA and ICBF, on the monthly salary (never below 1 SMMLV), proportional to the days worked for health, pension and occupational risk.

Document type must be neither PA nor CD; the operador validates the contributor against the UGPP file 'REPORTE DE PERSONAS NO AUTORIZADAS PARA EL USO DE LOS SUBTIPOS DE COTIZANTE 3 o 4' (AT2 v30 (24-07-2026) p.136).
